posts.name: TestSprite 4.0
posts.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
posts.description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

posts.name: Verse Engine by Ctruh
posts.tagline: Blender, Unity or Unreal to a live 3D link in one click
posts.description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.

posts.name: Netlify Server
posts.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
posts.description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

posts.name: Stripo Email Widgets
posts.tagline: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding
posts.description: Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

posts.name: Spellar for Chrome
posts.tagline: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser
posts.description: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

posts.name: Adside
posts.tagline: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you
posts.description: A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

posts.name: Tabstack by Mozilla
posts.tagline: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy
posts.description: Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

posts.name: Manufact
posts.tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
posts.description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

posts.name: Teaflask
posts.tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
posts.description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

posts.name: Gemini 4 Neon
posts.tagline: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
posts.description: Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

posts.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
posts.tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
posts.description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

posts.name: Cleared
posts.tagline: Your personal plan to give up vapes, pouches and cigarettes
posts.description: Most people who quit nicotine try without a plan. Cleared builds one from what you use, then helps every day: a check-in, a daily coach, one-tap logging and Craving SOS for the hard moments. Took a home nicotine test? Snap a photo and AI reads the result.

posts.name: Enrichable by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment
posts.description: Free, open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Build lead lists from a prompt, research every row with live web data, and find work emails.

posts.name: ToolJet
posts.tagline: Vibe-coded business apps that pass the security review
posts.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor build your internal tools in React. ToolJet is the platform underneath: 100+ data integrations, a built-in database, permissions, security scans on every save, version reviews, and workflows with human approvals.

posts.name: mio click
posts.tagline: A fidget that's also a friend
posts.description: mio click is a handheld clicker with one mechanical button and a tiny screen. Hatch a Squig, Goober or Meatball. No two are the same, and yours moves every time you press. It counts every click anywhere you take it, then syncs over Wi-Fi to a public leaderboard where you can see how your mio ranks, hatch a new one or swap with a friend. Assembled by hand in small batches by a team of parents. The button is rated for 50 million clicks.

posts.name: Impractical
posts.tagline: Make launch videos in the style of Framer, Notion, and more
posts.description: Pick a video template you like and make it about your product. Add your UI, copy and brand, then tell the AI what to change. Impractical helps founders and marketers make launch videos, feature announcements and explainers without building every video from scratch. Get started for free at impractical.ai! PS: If you're planning on doing your own launch, need a video, and don't know where to start, reach out! We're happy to directly work with startups to get them kickass videos with Impractical.

posts.name: Meilisearch Searchandising
posts.tagline: Pin, boost, hide and personalize search results
posts.description: New in Meilisearch Cloud: search rules and personalization. Build rules in a visual editor: drag a product to the top, boost or deboost by any filter, and hide what you don’t want to sell. Trigger rules on specific searches, category pages or every query, and schedule them for campaigns like Black Friday. Compare results with and without a rule before it goes live, no deploy needed. Personalization reranks results per user (experimental, on request). Same rules via the API, 3 free per project.

posts.name: Room AI
posts.tagline: Talk to it like a designer. Your room, one change at a time
posts.description: Upload a photo of your room and say what you'd change. Each reply is a new photo of your room with that change made and the rest left as it was. Every version kept, compare any two. No credits to count. Try it on your room first, no card.

posts.name: HeyGen Avatar 6
posts.tagline: AI Avatar Model That Looks Like You
posts.description: Avatar 6 is HeyGen’s most realistic AI avatar model, 84.4% indistinguishable from real footage. Your first video is free.

posts.name: Fieldwork Code
posts.tagline: AI coding on your laptop or in the cloud, from your phone
posts.description: Run parallel AI coding sessions with your choice of harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi or Fieldwork's own) and model, locally via our desktop app (free) or in cloud sandboxes ($50/mo). Pick up any session from the web or the Fieldwork mobile app. A side pane gives you a terminal, file diffs, PR status and CI checks, plus one-click instructions and inline diff reviews for your agent. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.

posts.name: Alfred 6
posts.tagline: Supercharging macOS since 2010
posts.description: Alfred 6 brings Alfred UI, a new macOS-native toolkit creators can use to build lightweight workflows with real interfaces. Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

posts.name: Every Signal
posts.tagline: Diligence on any company in an hour, every number sourced
posts.description: Every Signal's research agents take a company and a question and return a sourced teardown: traffic, ads, tracking stack, pricing, revenue math, competitors and rules. Every figure is tagged verified, estimate, inferred or rumour. Then it watches for changes.

posts.name: Tecla
posts.tagline: A proactive AI agent whose interface is a TODO list
posts.description: Tecla is a proactive AI assistant for work. It finds everything that's on your plate and turns it into a curated TODO list. You can click any item and Tecla does it for you. No prompts and no more text threads. You will never leave anything behind again. Just chat with people on Slack, exchange emails, have meetings, and tecla will understand what has to be done from those and surface the work, with all the required context.

posts.name: Play That Back
posts.tagline: A pro camera built for iPhone Duo
posts.description: Play That Back is a pro camera designed around the fold. Frame and control your shot inside while the person you're filming sees the live picture and chooses their look outside. Get cinematic looks, professional controls, and a clean original with every shot. It also works on iPhone and iPad. And on Mac, turn Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, photos, and AI videos into Recipes, compare your takes, and build your own looks.

posts.name: The Calm Creator Mastermind
posts.tagline: For solopreneurs who are tired of being solo.
posts.description: This is a small mastermind for creators, community builders, and indie founders who want to grow their business on their own terms, design a life they love, and treat their nervous system as a core measure of success alongside revenue. Other masterminds focus on growth at all costs. In this group, we're much more conscious of those costs. We commit to living a calm, balanced, and integrated life while growing the businesses and lives of our dreams.

posts.name: Nuko
posts.tagline: Motion design in your browser
posts.description: Open a template or start from scratch. Animate posts, stories and videos, then export.

posts.name: Polylane for Azure
posts.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Azure apps
posts.description: Polylane investigates Azure Monitor alerts, traces the cause through logs, metrics and resource changes, and prepares code fixes for review. It maps your subscription and connects it to your repos and other clouds. Connect through Azure Lighthouse with one template and no stored Azure credentials.

posts.name: Upsolve MCP Connections
posts.tagline: Plug Notion, Linear and more into your data agent
posts.description: Attach any MCP server to your Upsolve agent. Your agent still answers from governed warehouse data, and can now read and write where your team works: save an analysis to Notion, open a Linear ticket, pull context from docs.

posts.name: Ableten Hybrid AI Travel Planner
posts.tagline: Get your group on the same map.
posts.description: Group travel planning is hard: differing preferences, scattered recs, endless group chats. Ableten is a hybrid AI trip planner built for that mess. Ask for “ramen near Shinjuku” or “a Saturday in Lisbon” and get personalized suggestions on a real map — places you can drag into a shared itinerary. Everyone on the trip can add and pick what they love so that you can make real memories with friends, hassle free

posts.name: Source
posts.tagline: The attribution data layer for your agents to drive pipeline
posts.description: Source turns your website and CRM data into attribution your agents can query over MCP. Install the pixel, connect your CRM, then add Source from the Claude or OpenAI marketplace. Your agent can ask where pipeline came from and get the answer plus the SQL behind it. Six attribution models on every touch, from first visit to closed deal. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. Free up to 100,000 events a month. No credit card.

posts.name: OfinTech Desk
posts.tagline: Finance AI where every figure traces to its source
posts.description: Open-source AI workspace for finance teams where every figure traces to its source. Connect QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books or Odoo read-only and get statements, month-end close, KPIs and an assistant in Arabic or English. The AI explains; it never invents a number. Pro adds payment settlements, learning from your team's decisions and the Ofin model: no GPU, 0.03 ms per bank line on a 2-core CPU. Runs on your own servers.

posts.name: Rezora IO
posts.tagline: Shopify for AI voice agents: live in 10 minutes
posts.description: Rezora is the first AI voice platform that gives HVAC, plumbing, roofing and other home service companies self improving AI receptionists with setup and launch taking only 10 minutes. They answer the customer's questions, qualify the job, and book it on your calendar.

posts.name: CodeDesign v3
posts.tagline: Run your website and business apps from ChatGPT or Claude
posts.description: CodeDesign v3 turns an AI website builder into the place your business runs. Build a site from one sentence on 2,000+ designer templates, then run it from one new dashboard: domains, bookings, AI chatbot, forms, analytics, SEO checks, blog, email and social. New: connect CodeDesign to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor and do it all from the chat you already use. It still hosts on your domain, publishes to WordPress and exports code. 4M+ sites built.

posts.name: Noteshell
posts.tagline: AI teammates that build and run your workspace
posts.description: Noteshell is an AI workspace that can run itself once you decide what to delegate and when. Its AI teammates make custom dashboards, trackers, interactive notes, and mini-apps you can use together right inside Noteshell. No coding required. An agent can make your job tracker, then find and add matching roles each morning. Your workspace files live in folders on your computer.

posts.name: Mesh API
posts.tagline: Token-efficient AI gateway for 1,000+ models
posts.description: Cut your AI bill 2-4x by changing one line of code. Auto routing picks the cheapest model that clears your quality bar, direct model discounts take up to another 40% off list, and auto failover means your users never see an outage.

posts.name: Hub
posts.tagline: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5
posts.description: Open-source hub that runs hundreds of Claude Code or Codex sessions and brings you only the decisions, in your browser or in Telegram. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. Installs with one line.

posts.name: Bestboy
posts.tagline: Make a wish(list) from link, photo, voice, or ChatGPT
posts.description: Bestboy is a free wishlist app for families & friends who swap gifts. Save gift ideas for yourself or anyone you love: paste a link, snap a photo, or just say it. Collaborate on lists for a wedding registry, your child’s birthday or any occasion. Share one link, let people reserve gifts without signing up, so nobody buys the same thing twice. Unlike static wishlists, Bestboy reminds you of birthdays and gifts to buy. On iOS (even offline), web, Chrome, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok via MCP. Make a wish!

posts.name: Oodle AI
posts.tagline: Observability built for agents
posts.description: Oodle AI is observability built for agents: one platform for agent observability, logs, metrics, traces, APM, RUM, and infrastructure. Oodle gives agents full production context to debug apps, infra, and other agents. Built on open standards. Object storage for telemetry. Serverless compute for queries. Sub‑second agentic queries at 80% lower cost. Trusted by LanceDB, Truefoundry, Fello, WisdomAI, CultFit and more. 3PB+ of telemetry and 900M+ agent spans/month, zero sampling.

posts.name: Numora
posts.tagline: A unified interface for spending
posts.description: Money is messy. Your app shouldn’t be. One clean app for your personal and shared expenses, plus budgets that keep you on track. Bills remind you before they hit. Add expenses with a simple message on WhatsApp or Telegram. And then there’s Noo, your AI money assistant. It knows your spending, understands your habits, and helps you make smarter decisions.

posts.name: Localist
posts.tagline: Food tours: visit like a tourist, eat like a local
posts.description: Skip the tourist traps, eat where locals eat. Self-guided food tours through hand-picked local spots, at your own pace, every tasting included. Pick a tour, choose your date and go: the app guides you stop by stop on a map, with the story behind each place. At every stop, your tasting is waiting for you. No guide, no group to follow, no extra bill. Starting with Paris, more cities soon. On iOS and Android.

posts.name: InboxTrue
posts.tagline: Email verification. Checked, not guessed.
posts.description: InboxTrue verifies individual email addresses, even on catch-all domains where many tools stop at ‘unknown’. Address-level verdicts, disposable detection, realtime + bulk API, MCP for Claude and ChatGPT. Free checker, no signup.

posts.name: StarProphecy
posts.tagline: AI-powered astrology & personality reports for fun。
posts.description: StarProphecy generates AI-powered entertainment reports for astrology and personality fun. Get daily inspiration cards, weekly zodiac reports, name analyses, personality maps, and year-end forecasts based on your birth details. Unlike generic horoscope apps, we combine zodiac fun and Chinese zodiac culture into a lighthearted, shareable format. Delivered via Telegram or email. Launching Nov 19. Would love your feedback!

posts.name: Walk Me Up Alarm Clock
posts.tagline: The alarm that stops ringing only when you walk
posts.description: Stop losing your mornings to the snooze button. Walk Me Up only goes quiet once you've walked a set number of steps. By then you're out of bed and awake, not making deals with your phone. Set it once and get your mornings back.

posts.name: Duly
posts.tagline: Send invoices by texting your AI assistant
posts.description: Never open invoicing software again. Text your AI assistant who to bill and get a beautiful invoice with a pay link back in seconds. Works with Claude, Poke, Grok and any MCP assistant. $49 once, no subscription.

posts.name: Nav-vera
posts.tagline: Turn any floor plan into live indoor navigation in 24 hours
posts.description: Indoor spaces are the last unmapped frontier. Google Maps ends at the front door — inside, shoppers and workers are on their own. Nav-vera closes that gap. Upload a floor plan and get live indoor wayfinding in 24 hours. No app, no beacons, no site survey — all in the browser, with kiosk mode for stores and QR codes that drop visitors at the right entrance. Built for grocery, retail, hospitals, warehouses, malls, plants, and more. Live in US grocery retail and Indian electronics manufacturing.

posts.name: devrelScore
posts.tagline: Audit how developers find your devtool and what to fix
posts.description: devrelScore checks how often AI recommends you, your docs, website, GitHub, X and Discord, ranks you against competitors and gives you one score out of 100 with a prioritized list of fixes.

posts.name: Explorbot - autonomous web testing
posts.tagline: AI checks your web app so QA can focus on complex scenarios
posts.description: Explorbot is an AI exploratory testing agent for QA leads working with limited team capacity. It explores your running web app, plans and executes checks, and records steps, logs and video for review. Use it for initial checks on new features and repeated checks as they change. It helps reduce time spent clicking through the app, so testers can focus on complex scenarios and product risks. Your team reviews the findings and makes the final call.

posts.name: MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
posts.tagline: Microsoft’s new coding models, at a 50% launch price
posts.description: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash are Microsoft AI’s new coding models. Code 2 handles production code, deep debugging, multi-file work and UI. Flash covers explanations, targeted edits and routine fixes at lower cost. Per Microsoft, Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol’s performance at 40% of its cost. Both are at a 50% promotional price and available in GitHub Copilot. Flash is also in limited-access preview on Microsoft Foundry.

posts.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
posts.tagline: Return to Vice City in Rockstar's biggest GTA yet
posts.description: Grand Theft Auto VI brings Rockstar's legendary open-world series back to Vice City, set in the sprawling, Florida-inspired state of Leonida. Follow Jason and Lucia, two criminals caught in a conspiracy that stretches across the state, in the biggest and most immersive evolution of GTA yet. Explore a living world filled with unforgettable characters, places, and stories. Launching November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

posts.name: Dabbit
posts.tagline: Pick any color on your Mac, send it to Figma as variables
posts.description: A color-managed color picker for Mac. Pick any pixel exactly, copy it as Hex, OKLCH, SwiftUI or Tailwind and more, build palettes and scales, and send them to Figma as named variables with Light and Dark modes. Pay once, every update included.

posts.name: The Inkie Version
posts.tagline: 100 classic stories, read by a six-year-old's voice
posts.description: One classic children's story every morning for 100 days — Peter Rabbit, Puss in Boots, Rapunzel and more — each retold and read aloud by Inkie, the voice of a six-year-old boy, preserved exactly as he sounded. Episodes run about two minutes, land daily at 6 AM CT, and every one ends by pointing kids back to the book. It's the audio front door to Inklings Book Club, the free library-first reading app serving 10,000 kids through 17 library partners. Free forever.

posts.name: Duckling Crossing
posts.tagline: Mama Bird vs Morning Traffic
posts.description: You are a mama duck. The ducklings follow you everywhere. Get them to the pond before rush hour.

posts.name: SurSort Media Manager
posts.tagline: Your Smart Video & Audio Organizer for Windows & Mac
posts.description: Organize your video and audio files with AI-powered search, smart auto-tagging, and hover-to-play previews. Fully offline with local encryption. SurSort Media Manager — the fast, private media library that actually works.

posts.name: WeekCue
posts.tagline: Your AI concierge for everyday life
posts.description: Life is full of things to remember, plan, and keep track of. WeekCue makes it easier. Simply tell your AI concierge what's on your mind, and turn everyday requests into organized tasks, reminders, and plans. From personal to-dos to family schedules, WeekCue helps you stay on top of it all, without the constant mental juggling. Less remembering. More living.

posts.name: Columns Flow
posts.tagline: The End-to-End Data Automation Platform
posts.description: Creating a one-time data flow is effortless with AI, but establishing a repeatable automation process to consistently update everything from various sources is crucial for business operations. Columns Flow empowers you to automate the AI-driven work that delivers fresh insights directly to your inbox.

posts.name: PlatforMovie
posts.tagline: Ad-free movie & TV tracker that imports your Letterboxd
posts.description: Track movies and TV shows without ads on iOS, Android and the web, all in sync. Import your history from Letterboxd, IMDb, Trakt, TV Time and Refract in minutes. See where to stream in your country and get mood-based picks. Free to track and import.

posts.name: Gridline
posts.tagline: One API to run batch inference, fine-tune and distill models
posts.description: Fine-tune, distill and batch open models at a fraction of the cost of closed models. Gridline follows the OpenAI API, so your existing code works with a new base URL. Train your own model and run it on real workloads, all from one API. Fine-tunes from $0.50, batch from $0.029 per 1M tokens, and $5 free to start.

posts.name: Selects
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent a real video editor
posts.description: A professional video editor, built as a harness for your AI agent from day 1. Designed with pro editors: multicam, color, keyframes, transitions, captions. Our own analysis watches and listens to every minute (who’s speaking, what’s on screen, every word timed to the frame), so Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw or our chat edits with real context. Missing a tool? Describe it and Selects builds the app. Your video files stay on your drive. The editor is free; analysis and AI use credits.

posts.name: Travel Animator
posts.tagline: Create stunning travel videos with ready-made templates
posts.description: Travel Animator Templates make it effortless to create beautiful travel videos in seconds. Choose from split-screen road trips, flight journeys, and creative travel comparisons. Add your own clips, customize your journey, and export stunning videos without spending hours editing. Perfect for travelers and creators who want to share their adventures in a unique way.

posts.name: SourceSEO
posts.tagline: The Best Agentic SEO Service-as-a-Software
posts.description: SourceSEO runs 72+ AI agents that audit, fix, write and publish content across social media, industry-relevant websites and your own website to improve your SEO, AEO and GEO, with your approval at every step (should you choose to be the human in the loop). Else, everything can operate autonomously through the Auto-Mode. No more relying on large in-house SEO teams, or expensive SEO marketing agencies.

posts.name: certo.bio
posts.tagline: Your CV, verified at the source
posts.description: certo turns your CV into a verified career passport. Prove it's you in 30 seconds; past employers and your university confirm each job and degree, named on every line. One page you reuse for every application, with view stats. €9.90/year.

posts.name: ADE
posts.tagline: Cloud computers for your coding agents, from 1¢ an hour
posts.description: ADE runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 200+ models on cloud computers from 1¢ an hour, with 100 free hours every month. Agents coordinate on one job, test your app on Android simulators in the cloud (iOS through your Mac), get their own desktops, and open, fix and merge PRs from the chat. Works on Mac, Windows, Linux, web and iPhone. Free and open source.

posts.name: Leverprice
posts.tagline: Grow your revenue with price tests
posts.description: Earn more from the traffic you already have. Leverprice tests prices on new visitors, counts only the sales your payment provider confirms, and sends more traffic to the price that earns the most. It also gives every country a fair price from the first visit. Works with Stripe, Paddle, Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Dodo and Creem. Set up with one prompt to your AI agent. Free to start.

posts.name: Mirraa
posts.tagline: AI Interviewer for Recruiters & Hiring Teams
posts.description: Mirraa’s AI interviewer helps recruiters run structured first-round interviews at scale, evaluate candidates consistently and shortlist faster.

posts.name: Fecto
posts.tagline: Website growth by your coding agent. Pay only for results.
posts.description: Fecto gets your website more visits and enquiries from Google and AI assistants, and you only pay for growth it can prove. A free scan shows what's in the way and drafts the first fixes. One click hands the job to the coding agent you already use (Claude, Codex or Cursor), and every change is a pull request you review. Fecto's own tag counts the result: +20% is $30, +50% is $60, doubled is $100. Below +20% you pay $0.

posts.name: FitDiary: Chat-based food diary
posts.tagline: Macro counter & meal tracker
posts.description: Tell FitDiary what you ate the way you'd text a friend, say it out loud or snap a photo. It prepares the entry with calories and macros, you check it and confirm, and you can fix it just by saying so. Then ask about your own day: how much protein is left, what to eat tonight. Also inside: daily weight trend, streaks, supplement reminders and recipes with macros. iOS and Android, 10 languages, free trial.

posts.name: Opttab
posts.tagline: When agents shop, be the brand they choose
posts.description: Opttab is the Agentic Journey Operating System. We help brands and agencies get found, recommended and bought by AI agents. Win on 4 pillars: 🔍 Discoverability: See what AI agents can read on your site and the prompts buyers ask. 📊 Visibility: Track how agents and LLMs mention you vs competitors. Run AI ads. 🛠 Optimization: Get fixes ranked by impact and create content AI cites. 🤖 Merchant Agent: Connect your tools, build your brand's agent and publish it to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or your site.

posts.name: Motium
posts.tagline: AI recruitment platform for employers
posts.description: Motium is an AI recruitment platform. Its AI interviewers, Wren and Steven, interview every candidate live by video or voice in 12 languages, score the pillars that matter for each role on a 1 to 5 scale, and give your team the recording, transcript and evidence. A person makes every decision.

posts.name: Adwell
posts.tagline: Find the Apple Ads keywords that never pay for themselves
posts.description: Adwell joins every Apple Ads keyword to the trials, subscribers and refunds it brought, via RevenueCat. Each night it proposes pauses, bid changes and new keywords with the numbers behind them, and acts only after you approve. Ask it from Claude or ChatGPT.

posts.name: StudyRPG
posts.tagline: Turn any PDF into a tower defense game, an RPG and more
posts.description: Upload a textbook, lecture notes or an EPUB and StudyRPG builds a game world from it: every key idea, a mind map that explains them, and hundreds of questions with their source page. Play them as Tower Defense, where right answers pay for your towers, as a story with a region per chapter, an RPG, a platformer, mini-games, duels and races with friends, or flashcards. Everything runs on spaced repetition. Free public worlds, any language, web, iOS and Android.

posts.name: DearWords
posts.tagline: Name the moments that have no word yet. — DearMate
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Describe a moment that has no name. AI offers four words, everyone votes for a day, and only one survives — with a definition, a spoken pronunciation, a meme and a tiny game of its own.

posts.name: Kairos
posts.tagline: Lock in your borrow rate with onchain Interest Rate Swaps
posts.description: The first perpetual interest rate swap market for DeFi borrowers. If you borrow on Aave, Morpho, or Compound, your rate floats, sometimes violently. Kairos lets you fix it for 90 days without touching your position, with LPs pooled on the other side. What's different: no dated maturities (markets roll perpetually), no counterparty matching, manipulation-resistant time-weighted rate oracles, audited contracts. Real hedging, not farming. Lock rates, hedge positions and speculate on volatility!

posts.name: afterwatch
posts.tagline: Blameless postmortems from your Slack incident threads
posts.description: Afterwatch reads your Slack incident thread and writes a blameless postmortem in under a minute — timeline, root cause, impact and action items with owners. It only states what the thread supports and flags gaps instead of guessing. Free for 5 a month.

posts.name: No BS Weather: Feels Like
posts.tagline: Feels-like first, with a short summary and a free widget
posts.description: The thermometer and the feels-like number often disagree. This app puts the feels-like first, then a short summary of what the day means. Free, no ads, no account. Requires iOS 26. English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese.

posts.name: Wink
posts.tagline: The harness for self-improving frontier agents.
posts.description: Talk to one orchestrator and it spawns Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini and Muse agents in real terminals. When you correct it, it writes the lesson down, and on code it adds a check that fails if the mistake comes back. Your decisions are saved in your own words, with dates. Check in from your phone. Free, open source, Windows. Runs on the subscriptions you already pay for, no API keys.

posts.name: Gateweave
posts.tagline: Assign issues to AI agents, on your own Cloudflare account
posts.description: Gateweave Track is an open-source, realtime issue tracker. Assign an issue to an AI agent in Gateweave Agents: it works in a sandbox and opens a pull request for you to review. Both run on your own Cloudflare account as Workers, with no server to look after. AGPL-3.0. The demo opens without signing up.

posts.name: kept
posts.tagline: Know what you own. Get alerted when it's recalled.
posts.description: kept finds and remembers the details of everything you own: model numbers, filter sizes, paint codes, warranty dates - all of it. Scan a barcode or snap a photo to add items. kept automatically brings in the info. Ask the AI chat anything about your items, and get alerted when a CPSC recall matches something in your home. Free.

posts.name: Investor Matchmaking by PartnerMe AI
posts.tagline: AI finds the investors who actually fit your startup
posts.description: Stop pitching the wrong investors. Every request shows you the two investors who best fit your startup from a pool of 200 investors, with their public profiles, so you reach out on your terms. By approval on Plus and Team plans, when it fits both sides. Every paid plan also includes warm intros, auto-posts and replies, and boosted reach. Part of PartnerMe AI, your startup operating system: founders, professionals, influencers and AI agents collaborating as one network to grow, advance and scale.

posts.name: Timescreen
posts.tagline: A calm clock with a slowly turning Earth
posts.description: A free clock for a spare screen: real-time Earth, day and night, 28 styles, 60 palettes. Native Mac app and web, MIT, no account or subscription. Least risky thing I've shipped.

posts.name: PrintAIBook
posts.tagline: Turn your PDF or images into a real, printed book
posts.description: PrintAIBook turns any book into a real, bound book, softcover or hardcover. Made with AI (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva) or written by you. Upload a PDF, or build one from images with our free tool. Preview every page before you pay. No account, no ISBN, shipped worldwide.

posts.name: Athollus
posts.tagline: AI Experts and an AI Advisor for Small Businesses
posts.description: Software that gives your employees AI Experts for cash scenarios, supplier comparisons and contract work, reviewed before use, plus an AI Advisor for owners.

posts.name: Novela AI Search Simulation
posts.tagline: Learn how AI search works by running SEO and GEO for a brand
posts.description: Explore how brands get found in Google and in AI answers by running search for one yourself. Take over Beckwith & Co., an eyewear brand going direct to consumer. Ask its customers how they search, pick topics using SEO and AI search data side by side, set a budget and answer three positioning questions. An AI assistant reviews your answers and drafts the content. Then see your Google rank and AI visibility. Click Visit to try the free demo!

posts.name: AgentDrive
posts.tagline: Resume coding sessions across AI agents
posts.description: Hit your limit in one coding agent? Continue in another with the same context. AgentDrive syncs sessions across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and Antigravity and hands the next agent the goal, files touched and recent turns. Open source, free plan.

posts.name: AYK Maps
posts.tagline: Prompt a Map Animation Maker for Routes, Regions, Data Maps
posts.description: Most AI tools give you one shot. AYK Maps gives you a map you can keep improving. Describe it in a sentence and get an editable animated scene. Then refine it with follow-up prompts ("add a stop in Rome", "highlight Italy too", "make the route red") or edit any detail by hand: routes, highlighted countries, data maps, labels, callouts and camera moves. Each change updates the same map instead of starting over. When it looks right, export MP4 in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.

posts.name: GoClarion
posts.tagline: The sequence ends - the opportunity doesn’t
posts.description: Most outreach tools forget a lead when the sequence ends. GoClarion doesn’t. It researches every account for real buying signals, drafts emails with evidence, sends from your inbox when you approve, and brings leads back the moment they heat up.

posts.name: Haira
posts.tagline: AI resume screening, phone screens and video interviews
posts.description: Haira runs your first round of hiring. Build the job description with AI, rank every resume against it, and let an AI phone screen and an AI video interview with follow-up questions handle the first conversations. Each candidate gets a scored report on technical skills, job fit, communication and confidence, with a transcript, so your team compares finalists side by side and sends offers from one place.

posts.name: trove
posts.tagline: token savings you can verify
posts.description: Find out where your Claude Code tokens go. Trove quietly tests each fix on a copy of your sessions, only switches it on if it really saves, and undoes it if it stops working. Open source.

posts.name: Interval
posts.tagline: ADHD-friendly Daily Planner for Tasks & Notes
posts.description: Keep less in your head, get more done. Interval brings your tasks and notes together in a simple daily planner. No hourly grid, just 3 intervals: Morning, Afternoon, Evening. Type it straight into your day and get on with it.

posts.name: VisibilityOS
posts.tagline: Track AI visibility and earn the coverage that shapes it
posts.description: VisibilityOS by PodPitch tracks where your brand appears in AI answers and Google results, shows which competitors get mentioned, and helps you earn coverage through journalist, podcast, and newsletter outreach.

posts.name: Kira-AI
posts.tagline: AI voice interviews candidates actually finish
posts.description: Kira-AI interviews every applicant by voice and returns a scorecard against your criteria, each score quoted with a timestamp. Candidates answer from a browser link, with no camera and no app. A person on your team decides. Free trial: 25 interviews, no card.

posts.name: Busymail
posts.tagline: Your mail, for you and for your agent
posts.description: An IMAP email client for the mail you already have, with an MCP server so your AI assistant can work the same mailbox. It groups the inbox by what each message is - a bill with a due date, a flight, a code review - instead of by sender. A token can read, search, archive and draft, but it cannot send: drafts wait in an approval queue, and approving needs a signed-in session. Gmail, Yahoo, Fastmail or any IMAP server on an app password. 14 days free, no card, then $15 a month plus tax.

posts.name: Xannotate
posts.tagline: Screen record and Live call with screen share for agents
posts.description: Record your screen, point and speak, and hand it off to AI or do a live call with screen sharing to get realtime feedback about what's on the screen with Annotate Live, works with Claude, Codex, and Cursor and other coding agents.

posts.name: Simple Unmark
posts.tagline: Remove AI watermarks from your text, privately
posts.description: Simple Unmark removes AI watermarks from your text. Paste it in and the app strips the invisible characters some AI tools add, then rephrases it with a different model to change the word-choice patterns behind statistical watermarks like SynthID Text and textGrain. The rewrite aims to keep your meaning and facts. Copy the result and you're done. Private by default: your text and the output aren't saved in our database or analytics. Free to try.

posts.name: Cornerhold
posts.tagline: Commercial real estate on autopilot.
posts.description: Cornerhold is property management and accounting for commercial real estate: retail centers, offices and industrial buildings. Two AI readers abstract each lease and cite the page for every term. You bill rent and CAM from the lease. A billing check compares two years of billing with what your leases say and shows each gap in dollars. Use it on the web, or from ChatGPT, Claude and Grok through its MCP connector. A person approves whatever the AI drafts or proposes.

posts.name: Quando
posts.tagline: A calendar that shows your free time on a timeline
posts.description: A calendar for iPhone, iPad and Mac with a Timeline: one row per day, hours across, free time shown as empty space. Write events the way you talk. No account, no ads, no tracking; syncs through your own iCloud. Free, with optional Pro.

posts.name: Glowstand – Music Visualizer
posts.tagline: Turn your iPhone or iPad into an LED spectrum analyzer
posts.description: Glowstand turns your iPhone or iPad into an LED spectrum analyzer, like the meters on studio gear. It listens through the microphone, so it works with anything that plays in the room: music from a streaming service, a turntable or an instrument. Turn on Transmit on one device and any other device on the same Wi-Fi network can show the panel too, each in its own layout and colors. 12 layouts, 39 themes, 9 screensavers. And the Album Art Colors theme takes the colors of the song's cover.

posts.name: SaberCharge
posts.tagline: Your Mac's battery icon, as a glowing saber blade
posts.description: SaberCharge replaces the Mac menu bar battery icon with a glowing blade. It grows as you charge, shrinks as you drain, ignites when you plug in and flickers when you're low. 16 colours, battery health, low battery alerts. Native Swift, no account, no tracking.

posts.name: Swingback
posts.tagline: Turn user feedback into GitHub and Linear issues
posts.description: Collect feature requests and votes in a portal or in-app widget. Turn requests into GitHub or Linear issues. When an issue closes, Swingback marks the request done and emails every voter. AI flags duplicates. Free plan. Pro is a flat $20/mo.

posts.name: Anyway
posts.tagline: Never read the same story twice
posts.description: Anyway transforms reading into an adventure where you and your child make choices that reshape the story. Every decision leads to a unique ending and a tailored moral lesson. Active learning, zero boredom.

posts.name: Wedding Planner
posts.tagline: Checklist, budget, guests and vendors in one offline file
posts.description: Wedding Planner is a wedding planning app in one HTML file. It has a checklist of 69 tasks with due dates set from your wedding day, a budget tracker, a guest list with RSVPs and vendor cards. Works offline. No account, no subscription. Print or save as PDF.
